9b6f17099c4a5a90d922.en: A main clause makes sense on its own.
9b6f17099c4a5a90d922.id: Induk kalimat (main clause) bisa dipahami walaupun berdiri sendiri.

8bf39e9e01df281b617f.en: Some clauses cannot stand alone. They start with words like when, because, although, if, until and while.
8bf39e9e01df281b617f.id: Ada klausa (clause) yang tidak bisa berdiri sendiri. Klausa ini dimulai dengan kata seperti when, because, although, if, until, dan while.

cd3def62e53b133a7e87.en: A complex sentence joins a main clause to one of these clauses.
cd3def62e53b133a7e87.id: Kalimat majemuk (complex sentence) menggabungkan induk kalimat dengan salah satu klausa itu.

145210c407ff6b76ad42.en: Each joining word has a job. Because gives a reason, although shows a contrast and until shows a time limit.
145210c407ff6b76ad42.id: Setiap kata penghubung punya tugas. Because memberi alasan, although menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan, dan until menunjukkan batas waktu.

8af9e656c03cb207d7fe.en: If the joining clause comes first, put a comma before the main clause.
8af9e656c03cb207d7fe.id: Kalau klausa dengan kata penghubung ada di depan, taruh koma sebelum induk kalimat.

ea5f287b97a3a7a82132.en: Until means up to the time when. We waited until the rain stopped.
ea5f287b97a3a7a82132.id: Until berarti sampai saat sesuatu terjadi. We waited until the rain stopped.

4d3f66187b179e9340fa.en: Although it was late cannot stand alone. It is joined to the main clause we kept playing.
4d3f66187b179e9340fa.id: Although it was late tidak bisa berdiri sendiri. Bagian ini digabungkan dengan induk kalimat (main clause) we kept playing.

88a87ba20c8d738acbb1.en: Because gives the reason: we stayed inside because it was raining.
88a87ba20c8d738acbb1.id: Because memberi alasan: we stayed inside because it was raining.

c6b758e20dc628245c9d.en: Although shows a contrast. It was late, but Arif kept reading anyway.
c6b758e20dc628245c9d.id: Although menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan. Hari sudah larut, tetapi Arif tetap membaca.

9385c216d428ddd37c18.en: The children ran outside makes sense on its own, so it is the main clause. When the bell rang needs the rest of the sentence.
9385c216d428ddd37c18.id: The children ran outside punya arti walaupun berdiri sendiri, jadi bagian ini adalah induk kalimat (main clause). When the bell rang masih memerlukan bagian kalimat lainnya.

93d14ed5a64fe72600bd.en: Each joining word has a job. If shows a condition, until shows a time limit and while shows two things at once. Because gives a reason, and although shows a contrast.
93d14ed5a64fe72600bd.id: Setiap kata penghubung punya tugas. If menunjukkan syarat, until menunjukkan batas waktu, dan while menunjukkan dua hal yang terjadi bersamaan. Because memberi alasan, dan although menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan.

2252453fc62e260779a3.en: Although it was sunny is the first clause, so a comma goes after sunny, before the main clause.
2252453fc62e260779a3.id: Although it was sunny adalah klausa (clause) pertama, jadi koma ditulis setelah sunny, sebelum induk kalimat (main clause).

2e9085f769f6a47af101.en: If you finish early is the first clause, so the comma goes after early. You can read a book is the main clause.
2e9085f769f6a47af101.id: If you finish early adalah klausa (clause) pertama, jadi koma ditulis setelah early. You can read a book adalah induk kalimat (main clause).

16c178d55d9be4f9a7ff.en: Main clauses like the dog barked make sense alone. Clauses that start with because, when, although or if need a main clause.
16c178d55d9be4f9a7ff.id: Induk kalimat (main clause) seperti the dog barked punya arti walaupun berdiri sendiri. Klausa (clause) yang dimulai dengan because, when, although, atau if memerlukan induk kalimat.

bd2806faf38fbf65a54e.en: Unless means if you do not. You cannot play unless you tidy your room.
bd2806faf38fbf65a54e.id: Unless berarti kalau tidak (if you do not). You cannot play unless you tidy your room.

08b9748b779e027ee9d6.en: After the rain stopped and while Dad cooked cannot stand alone. Each is joined to a main clause, so those sentences are complex.
08b9748b779e027ee9d6.id: After the rain stopped dan while Dad cooked tidak bisa berdiri sendiri. Masing-masing digabungkan dengan induk kalimat (main clause), jadi kalimat-kalimat itu adalah kalimat majemuk (complex sentence).

988cd649ecdede898e16.en: Until means up to the time when. You stir the soup until it bubbles, and then you stop.
988cd649ecdede898e16.id: Until berarti sampai saat sesuatu terjadi. Kamu mengaduk sup until it bubbles, lalu kamu berhenti.

14383a6d7981f03955b8.en: Since it was Sunday cannot stand alone. It is joined to the main clause the shops opened late, so the sentence is complex.
14383a6d7981f03955b8.id: Since it was Sunday tidak bisa berdiri sendiri. Bagian ini digabungkan dengan induk kalimat (main clause) the shops opened late, jadi kalimat itu adalah kalimat majemuk (complex sentence).

3becb57775d266bb4a49.en: In Since it was raining, we took the bus, since gives a reason, so it means because. In the others, since means from a time.
3becb57775d266bb4a49.id: Pada Since it was raining, we took the bus, kata since memberi alasan, jadi artinya because. Pada kalimat lainnya, since berarti sejak suatu waktu.

c7dc58099f572701cd5e.en: Because joins the reason (it was cold) to the action (I put on my coat).
c7dc58099f572701cd5e.id: Because menghubungkan alasan (it was cold) dengan perbuatan (I put on my coat).

0f3e18c60f95c3421422.en: Until starts the extra clause: until the rain stopped.
0f3e18c60f95c3421422.id: Until memulai klausa tambahan: until the rain stopped.

01a8affe249a70facc39.en: Although it was late is the extra clause. Hadi kept reading is the main clause.
01a8affe249a70facc39.id: Although it was late adalah klausa tambahan. Hadi kept reading adalah induk kalimat (main clause).

e5e2567ff34599ad515a.en: Because tells us the reason Citra can swim, so it joins the two clauses.
e5e2567ff34599ad515a.id: Because memberi tahu alasan Citra bisa berenang, jadi kata ini menghubungkan kedua klausa (clause).

f36a67295c37b51d365e.en: Each ending adds an idea that fits: a time, a surprise, a reason or something happening at once.
f36a67295c37b51d365e.id: Setiap akhir kalimat menambahkan ide yang cocok: waktu, kejutan, alasan, atau sesuatu yang terjadi bersamaan.

c4967ea14ca7d67c4c10.en: When the extra clause comes first, a comma goes between it and the main clause.
c4967ea14ca7d67c4c10.id: Kalau klausa tambahan ada di depan, koma ditulis di antara klausa itu dan induk kalimat (main clause).

817907c369200ecb3111.en: While her mum cooked cannot stand on its own, so it is the subordinate clause.
817907c369200ecb3111.id: While her mum cooked tidak bisa berdiri sendiri, jadi bagian ini adalah anak kalimat (subordinate clause).

4a9cf2bcfeea587b2590.en: Complex sentences use a joining word such as because, unless or although to attach an extra clause.
4a9cf2bcfeea587b2590.id: Kalimat majemuk (complex sentence) memakai kata penghubung seperti because, unless, atau although untuk menyambungkan klausa tambahan.

dd8b62906c9e6edd90a4.en: Although shows a contrast: Hadi still wanted the book even though he had little money.
dd8b62906c9e6edd90a4.id: Although menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan: Hadi tetap menginginkan buku itu walaupun uangnya sedikit.

4332bc3021705e5d24a3.en: Unless means if not, so the plants will die unless you water them.
4332bc3021705e5d24a3.id: Unless berarti kalau tidak (if not), jadi kalimatnya menjadi the plants will die unless you water them.

c425ae7534522925b437.en: Unless means if not, and until shows she waits up to the time her brother arrives.
c425ae7534522925b437.id: Unless berarti kalau tidak (if not), dan until menunjukkan dia menunggu sampai saudara laki-lakinya datang.

fe24fc6ff694272bc8b0.en: Although the bus was late is only a subordinate clause. It needs a main clause to complete it.
fe24fc6ff694272bc8b0.id: Although the bus was late hanyalah anak kalimat (subordinate clause). Bagian ini perlu induk kalimat (main clause) supaya lengkap.

17fb190c2e2b2d3ac384.en: In both correct sentences, the extra clause comes first and a comma follows it.
17fb190c2e2b2d3ac384.id: Pada kedua kalimat yang benar, klausa tambahan ada di depan dan diikuti koma.

433941d91070104c8ef8.en: Although shows the contrast. The comma sits between the two clauses.
433941d91070104c8ef8.id: Although menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan. Koma ada di antara kedua klausa (clause).

909f92edd7c08ed1cce1.en: After tells us when Leo packed his bag.
909f92edd7c08ed1cce1.id: After memberi tahu kapan Leo mengemas tasnya.

b7764a42bf9db7f2a631.en: In the second sentence, before is followed by dinner was ready, which has a subject and a verb. So it joins two clauses.
b7764a42bf9db7f2a631.id: Pada kalimat kedua, before diikuti dinner was ready, yang punya subjek (subject) dan kata kerja (verb). Jadi before menghubungkan dua klausa (clause).

836634184e6475874bbf.en: Although and because join clauses, so they are connectives.
836634184e6475874bbf.id: Although dan because menghubungkan klausa (clause), jadi keduanya adalah kata penghubung (connective).

93f9b82b34e9d055dbc8.en: Before, until and after link time. Because and so that link reasons. Although and but show contrast.
93f9b82b34e9d055dbc8.id: Before, until, dan after menghubungkan waktu. Because dan so that menghubungkan alasan. Although dan but menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan.

2df8b86df1cece347e1e.en: Because joins the two clauses and gives the reason.
2df8b86df1cece347e1e.id: Because menghubungkan kedua klausa (clause) dan memberi alasan.

1bf0ca2c532375b4df85.en: Because is a conjunction that joins a main clause to a clause that gives the reason.
1bf0ca2c532375b4df85.id: Because adalah kata penghubung (conjunction) yang menghubungkan induk kalimat (main clause) dengan klausa yang memberi alasan.

40433b406c38d7e5cd6a.en: Although is a conjunction. It joins clauses, for example Although it was cold, we went out.
40433b406c38d7e5cd6a.id: Although adalah kata penghubung (conjunction). Kata ini menghubungkan klausa (clause), misalnya Although it was cold, we went out.

fc67d0baa59f88aec4b0.en: A complex sentence has a main clause and a subordinate clause. Although it was cold is the subordinate clause.
fc67d0baa59f88aec4b0.id: Kalimat majemuk (complex sentence) punya induk kalimat (main clause) dan anak kalimat (subordinate clause). Although it was cold adalah anak kalimat.

ba5c300093af32532372.en: Unless means if not. Because gives a reason.
ba5c300093af32532372.id: Unless berarti kalau tidak (if not). Because memberi alasan.

17f6f4746d112c0d1950.en: Unless means if not, so we will go to the beach only if it does not rain.
17f6f4746d112c0d1950.id: Unless berarti kalau tidak (if not), jadi kita akan pergi ke pantai hanya kalau tidak hujan.

8e41165dee3266ad0d0e.en: Until joins the main clause to a clause telling us when the waiting stops.
8e41165dee3266ad0d0e.id: Until menghubungkan induk kalimat (main clause) dengan klausa yang memberi tahu kapan menunggunya berhenti.
